description: npm client only. Deliver Game Kits straight into an engine project folder on this machine: hashes project_dir/gripforge/**, reads gripforge/gamekits.lock.json, asks the GripForge API for the plan, then executes plan.actions with fs — every overwritten or deleted file is copied to gripforge/.backup/<plan id>/ first and the lock is written last. Paths are checked inside project_dir (Godot: gripforge/ and assets/gripforge/ only) and every hash is verified before anything is written. Run dry_run=true first. A blocked plan (conflicts, breaking update) returns the conflicts without touching files: re-run with force or accept_breaking. verify=true runs Godot headless (import, then each kit smoke.gd) when GODOT_BIN is set. Undo with gripforge_gamekit_rollback_local. Credits: the first delivery of a kit major version to an engine costs 1 credit per workspace; re-deliveries, updates within a major and dry runs are free.

dry_run.description: true → plan only; nothing is written or charged.

force.description: true → back up then overwrite edited managed files and existing seed files.

kits.description: Kits to deliver (at most 16). Omit to deliver the enabled kits of project_id.

config.description: Kit config, validated against its configSchema.

id.description: Kit id from the catalogue, dotted (e.g. vehicle.driveable).

version.description: Exact version; only the latest is deliverable.

mode.description: install (default), update to the latest catalogue version, or uninstall (uses the lock).

project_dir.description: Absolute path of the engine project (for Godot: the folder holding project.godot).

project_id.description: Game Kit project (gkp_…) whose enabled kits, config and bindings are delivered when kits is omitted.

target.description: Engine of the project: godot (default), unity or unreal.

verify.description: true → after writing, run Godot headless (import + smoke.gd per kit) when GODOT_BIN is set.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_gamekit_deliver_local
title: Deliver Game Kits into a local engine project
